prompt: From the start the camera drifts forward very slowly along the shelf, closing in on the second stone in the row, the nearest stone sliding gently toward the frame edge. Warm light shifts a little across the wooden wall as if a cloud passed outside, and the stones gleam faintly as it moves. The bamboo leaves in the vase tremble. The shop stays empty and perfectly quiet. All printed words stay sharp and exactly the same: EXIT THROUGH GIFT SHOP, NON-ATTACHMENT £24, £80. Calm, still, expensive.
